data.one_liner: Flexible Flutter HTTP client built on Dio with mock support, caching, and token management.
data.what_it_does: DioFlow is an HTTP client built on Dio that offers structured request handling, automatic token refreshing, local caching, and request mocking out of the box.
use_when: You need a structured networking layer with built-in token management and single-flight refresh.
You want offline request mocking and built-in caching for GET requests.
You want robust retry logic and safe FormData cloning.
avoid_when: You prefer using raw Dio directly without wrapper response models.
Your project does not require an HTTP networking client.
strengths: Isolated local caching with query-key stabilization
weaknesses: Tied to a specific wrapper API instead of standard Dio clients
Adds an opinionated layer over Dio that you must learn
data.setup_notes: Initialize DioFlowConfig and ApiClient in main().

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using the standard Dio client without wrappers.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight built-in HTTP client instead of Dio.
